name: Asylum Seeker VET Program (ASVET)
summary: Lets eligible asylum seekers and refugees in Victoria study Skills First courses at concession fees, plus select Free TAFE courses.
who: Humanitarian, protection or refugee visa holders and their dependants
Bridging visa holders who have applied for a humanitarian, protection or refugee visa
how: Contact the Asylum Seeker Resource Centre for a referral letter, or enrol directly with a Skills First provider

source.label: Victorian Government: Asylum Seeker VET program

evidence.quote: ASVET participants are also eligible for discounted course fees across all Skills First courses.
This applies even if the student does not hold a concession card.
